rules.statement: A mortgage decree does not necessarily extinguish the mortgage, but imposes a new charge on the land.
rules.supporting_quote: "On the institution of lis pendens, the mortgaged land becomes liable to be affected by the judgment, upon decree it becomes actually so affected. By the operation of the same principle, the order for the sale is binding upon any subsequent purchaser until the order has been finally carried out. It thus imposes a charge which prejudicially affects him."
